parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region where the task is started. Valid values:

*   ap-southeast-1: Singapore
*   ap-southeast-5: Indonesia (Jakarta)
*   cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
*   cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-pull-to-push --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 3efb43c5-18ff-49eb-92a6-005f65210000 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
